title: DIFFPREP for DTI Processing
author: Courtney Comrie
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.89rhz56
materials: Change directories to the containers. cd /rsgrps/hutchinsone/Singularity_Containers

steps.title: Create processing directory and copy data
steps.instruction: In a terminal, make a new working directory for the DTI data and copy the raw Bruker files into it so that only the copied data will be processed.

steps.title: Navigate to data directory
steps.instruction: Change to the newly created directory that contains the copied raw data.

steps.title: Import Bruker blip‑up and blip‑down
steps.instruction: Use the ImportBruker command to import the forward (blip‑up) and reverse (blip‑down) phase‑encoding scans.

steps.title: Load singularity neurotools container
steps.instruction: Load the singularity module and start the neurotools container that provides TORTOISE and related utilities.

steps.title: Inspect image orientation
steps.instruction: Open the imported DTI NIFTI file in ITKSNAP (or MIPAV / MRtrix mrview) and note the image orientation; the raw blip‑down image should be in RPS but you will need LPS for later steps.

substeps.instruction: File → Import → select the DTI NIFTI file
Record the orientation of the blip‑down image

steps.title: Generate .list file with ImportNIFTI
steps.instruction: Create the .list file required by DIFFPREP by running ImportNIFTI with the appropriate phase‑encoding direction and auxiliary files.

steps.title: Reorient blip‑down image
steps.instruction: Run ReorientImage on the blip‑down .list file (located in the proc folder) to correct its inverse orientation.

steps.title: Verify reorientation
steps.instruction: Extract a 3‑D volume from the reoriented 4‑D image with ExtractImage and view it in ITKSNAP to confirm correct orientation.

steps.title: Create DIFF_PREP_WORK folder
steps.instruction: In your home directory, make a folder named DIFF_PREP_WORK and copy the appropriate settings template into it.

steps.title: Edit settings file for current scan
steps.instruction: Open IVmouse_2D.dmc with a text editor and modify the parameters to match your scan (e.g., correction mode, EPI correction, Gibbs ringing, up‑sampling, pre‑smoothing, FOV, resolution).

substeps.instruction: Turn off "EPI Correction" unless DRBUDDI will not be used
Enter the three values for FOV and Resolution from the methods file
Adjust any other options required for the animal (ferret vs mouse, etc.)

steps.title: Run DIFFPREP on both phase‑encodings
steps.instruction: Execute DIFFPREP separately for the blip‑up list and the reoriented blip‑down list, using the edited settings file.

steps.title: Organize multiple blip scan folders (if needed)
steps.instruction: If the blip‑up or blip‑down data are split across two scans each, create a parent folder for each phase‑encoding, move the raw scans into sub‑folders named 01 and 02, and point ImportBruker to the parent folder.

substeps.instruction: ImportBruker -i blip_up_folder -c 1   # uses the sub‑folders automatically

steps.title: Create bval and bvec files
steps.instruction: Generate the FSL‑compatible bval and bvec files from the TORTOISE b‑matrix file (only once, as both phase‑encodings share the same matrix).

steps.title: Optional visualization with MIPAV or mrview
steps.instruction: If desired, launch MIPAV or MRtrix’s mrview from within the singularity container for additional image inspection.

substeps.instruction: singularity run nklab-neurotools-v0.4.sif mrview   # launch mrview
